# Summit Marketing

> We train and field sales reps in pest control, fiber internet, and life insurance. You close, you get paid on what you close.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Summit Marketing, the industry toggle, and the earnings calculator.
- [Pest Control](/industries/pest): The summer product — how pest works and how you get paid.
- [Fiber Internet](/industries/fiber): The winter product — paid per install.
- [Life Insurance](/industries/life): In development.
- [Recruiting](/recruiting): What the role looks like, and how to apply.
- [Rookie Application](/apply/rookie): Apply as a first-time sales rep.
- [Veteran Application](/apply/veteran): Apply as an experienced sales professional.
